:::{#def-empirical-cdf}
#### Empirical CDF

For observed values $x_1, \ldots, x_n$,
the **empirical cumulative distribution function** (**empirical CDF**)
is the function

$$\hat F(t) \eqdef \frac{1}{n}\sum_{j=1}^n I(x_j \le t), \quad t \in \reals,$$

where $I(A)$ is the indicator function:
$I(A) = 1$ if $A$ holds,
and $I(A) = 0$ otherwise.
:::
